# T4 — What predicts the external error of an imputed cell? (Task 2.3)

*Generated by `analysis/notes.py` from `outputs/tables/T4_error_covariates.csv` and `T4b_error_by_trust.csv`.*

**Claim.** Absolute level error rises with the number of months since the market last reported the item: +0.16 percentage points per month (SE 0.06, p = 0.008; pooled clean strata, item × month fixed effects, two-way clustered). RTFP's own trust score predicts error only weakly (univariate -1.13 points per trust point, p = 0.019; not significant with other regressors), and 86% of clean cells have trust 10. Distance to the nearest observed market does not predict error in the cross-sectional stratum.

**Regressions:**

| sample | regressor | coef | se | p | n |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pooled | gap_final | 0.165 | 0.062 | 0.008 | 5701 |
| pooled | trust_final | -0.672 | 0.430 | 0.118 | 5701 |
| pooled | vintage_age_m | -0.190 | 0.180 | 0.291 | 5701 |
| cross_sectional | gap_final | 0.309 | 0.139 | 0.026 | 820 |
| cross_sectional | trust_final | -0.258 | 1.215 | 0.832 | 820 |
| cross_sectional | vintage_age_m | 0.288 | 0.286 | 0.315 | 820 |
| cross_sectional | dist_100km | 0.214 | 0.566 | 0.706 | 820 |
| forecast | gap_final | 0.134 | 0.067 | 0.046 | 4881 |
| forecast | trust_final | -0.730 | 0.426 | 0.087 | 4881 |
| forecast | vintage_age_m | -0.058 | 0.023 | 0.010 | 4881 |

**Mean absolute error by trust score:**

| trust_bin | n | mean_abs_err_pct | median_abs_err_pct |
|---|---|---|---|
| (0.0, 5.999] | 25 | 9.014 | 8.844 |
| (5.999, 7.999] | 57 | 5.861 | 3.868 |
| (7.999, 9.999] | 701 | 4.586 | 2.917 |
| (9.999, 10.0] | 4985 | 4.286 | 3.043 |

**Method.** Outcome 100·|log(c_final / y_eval)|. Covariates measured in the imputing release. RTFP's `data_coverage` field is one value per release for all markets, so it is not used.

**Caveats.** Exploratory. Little variation in trust among clean cells. Distance is undefined for forecast cells.

**Files.** `outputs/tables/T4_error_covariates.csv`, `T4b_error_by_trust.csv`, `T4c_covariate_summary.csv`; script `analysis/t4_error_covariates.py`.
